what_it_does: PAF-Enc reduces wear in emerging non-volatile memory chips by minimizing unnecessary write operations. When data is written to memory, the chip compares the new data with existing data and only changes bits that differ. If new and old data are very different, many bits must flip, wearing out the memory. PAF-Enc encodes incoming data using XOR bit operations to make it closer to what is already stored, reducing bit flips and extending memory lifetime.
